_note: A Svelte-4 TypeScript component with a `<slot>` had its props wrapped in `Partial<…>`, so a consumer omitting a required prop passed silently. Upstream's `__sveltets_2_PropsWithChildren` only adds `children?: any` (for a default slot) and never makes the props optional for a TS file; the missing `title` is reported. This TS2322 is on the constructor options' `props` key, which svelte2tsx writes right after the moved tag name, so it lands on the tag name's last character.
